description: Recalibration of the small-probe promotion gate (bot/strategy_engine.py:_maybe_promote_wait_to_small_probe), the only code path that can convert a judge 'wait' on a valid prepare_* plan into approve_trade without a perfect trigger fill. A 72h audit (8 tickers, all +1.8%..+8.3%) found this path fired 0/64 times because two of its gates were miscalibrated against the real analyst-score distribution, not because the market lacked opportunities. See reports/audits/entry-funnel-72h-latest.md, reports/audits/missed-opportunities-72h-latest.md, reports/audits/recent-market-move-latest.md, reports/backtests/recent-market-parameter-sweetspot-latest.md.
rollback_instructions: Set every parameter below back to its 'current' (pre-fix) value via the approved_parameter_profile route, or revert bot/config.py / bot/strategy_engine.py to before commit tagged 2026-07-02 small-probe recalibration.

SMALL_PROBE_MAX_BEAR_BULL_GAP.current: 4 (as bear_score >= max(40, bull_score-4), i.e. an absolute veto)
SMALL_PROBE_MAX_BEAR_BULL_GAP.reason: The bear-case analyst prompt is structurally more pessimistic than the bull-case prompt. Across 64 valid prepare_* plans in the 72h window (market +1.8%..+8.3%), bear_score exceeded bull_score in 64/64 cases (median gap +29, min gap +1, max +48) -- the old absolute veto vetoed literally every candidate regardless of setup quality.
SMALL_PROBE_MAX_BEAR_BULL_GAP.evidence: reports/audits/entry-funnel-72h-latest.json:reject_reasons_at_judge; scratch simulation in reports/backtests/recent-market-parameter-sweetspot-latest.json profile A_current_pre_fix promoted_count=0/64
SMALL_PROBE_MAX_BEAR_BULL_GAP.expected_effect: Only vetoes candidates where the bear case dominates the bull case by a wide (top-quartile) margin, instead of vetoing on any nonzero bear-lean.
SMALL_PROBE_MAX_BEAR_BULL_GAP.risk: LOW-MEDIUM: widens the promotion aperture; bounded by the still-active per-branch quality thresholds below and the small fixed probe size (20-25 USDC).

SMALL_PROBE_REQUIRE_HTF_BOTH_TIMEFRAMES.current: false (OR semantics: either 4h EMA50<EMA200 OR 1h EMA20<EMA50 blocks)
SMALL_PROBE_REQUIRE_HTF_BOTH_TIMEFRAMES.reason: 46/64 valid candidates were blocked purely by the LAGGING 4h EMA50/EMA200 cross (normal for the first 1-2 weeks of a fresh reversal) while the FASTER 1h structure was already bullish. 0/64 were blocked by the 1h leg alone. Requiring both timeframes to agree removes the lag-only false negative while still blocking the 17/64 cases where both legs genuinely agree the trend is down.
SMALL_PROBE_REQUIRE_HTF_BOTH_TIMEFRAMES.expected_effect: Stops vetoing candidates solely because a slow-moving 4h moving average hasn't caught up yet.
SMALL_PROBE_REQUIRE_HTF_BOTH_TIMEFRAMES.risk: LOW: strictly removes a stale-indicator false negative; does not weaken the check for genuinely bearish setups (both legs still block).

SMALL_PROBE_TC_SYNTH_MIN.reason: Live synth_confidence distribution on valid prepare_breakout plans: p75=73, max=79 -- the old 78 threshold admitted almost nothing.

SMALL_PROBE_TC_BULL_MIN.reason: Live bull_score distribution: p75=58, p90=61, max=68 -- 64 excluded everything but the top ~5%.

SMALL_PROBE_TC_BREAKOUT_CONFIRMATION_MIN.reason: Live breakout_confirmation_score distribution: median=38, p75=46, max=67 -- 60 excluded nearly everything.

SMALL_PROBE_TC_VOL_15M_MIN.reason: Live 15m volume_vs_avg on valid candidates: p25=0.7, median=1.0 -- 0.95 excluded roughly half of genuinely average-volume setups.

SMALL_PROBE_TC_VOL_1H_MIN.reason: Live 1h volume_vs_avg median was 0.8; 0.85 excluded over half of candidates including several with clearly rising volume trend.

SMALL_PROBE_RC_SYNTH_MIN.reason: Same distribution issue as TC_SYNTH_MIN, applied to the reclaim_reversal branch.

SMALL_PROBE_RC_BULL_MIN.reason: Same distribution issue as TC_BULL_MIN, applied to the reclaim_reversal branch.

SMALL_PROBE_RC_BREAKOUT_CONFIRMATION_MIN.reason: Same distribution issue as TC_BREAKOUT_CONFIRMATION_MIN, applied to the reclaim_reversal branch.

SMALL_PROBE_RC_VOL_15M_MIN.reason: Same distribution issue as TC_VOL_15M_MIN, applied to the reclaim_reversal branch.

SMALL_PROBE_RC_VOL_1H_MIN.reason: Same distribution issue as TC_VOL_1H_MIN, applied to the reclaim_reversal branch.

PHASE_D2_MIN_EXPECTED_NET_EDGE_PCT.reason: D2 economics do not run in the entry path at all (assess_minimum_net_edge is only called from build_multi_exit_bracket_lite_plan, post-fill). Changing this parameter would have zero effect on why the bot opens 0 positions.

PHASE_D2_MIN_REWARD_TO_FEE_RATIO.reason: Same as above -- not in the entry path.

PHASE_D2_MIN_REWARD_TO_RISK_RATIO.reason: Same as above -- not in the entry path.

MAX_SPREAD_PCT.reason: Spread was never the binding constraint in the 72h audit window (typical spreads ~0.01-0.03%, two orders of magnitude below the cap).

JUDGE_MIN_GATE_CONFIDENCE.reason: This is the entry-gate hard filter, not the small-probe promotion gate; 86/144 records already passed it in the audit window. Not the bottleneck.

MAX_OPEN_POSITIONS.reason: 0 open positions today, far from this cap; not a blocker. (Separately fixed: this parameter was whitelisted but never mapped in BotConfig.__post_init__, making it a silent no-op via the approved-profile route -- fixed 2026-07-02 in bot/config.py.)

DEFAULT_QUOTE_SIZE_USDC.reason: Small-probe promotions use their own fixed 20-25 USDC size (bot/strategy_engine.py probe_size), not this default; irrelevant to the fix.

code_fixes_applied.description: mixed_context veto changed from an absolute bear_score>=max(40,bull-4) check (true in 64/64 live candidates) to a relative bear-minus-bull gap check against a configurable threshold (default 32, calibrated to the live p75 gap). bearish_htf changed from OR to AND semantics across the 4h and 1h EMA checks, removing the 46/64 false-negative caused by a lagging 4h EMA alone. All setup-specific quality thresholds (synth/bull/breakout_confirmation/volume) moved from hardcoded literals to bot/config.py fields, recalibrated to real live-data percentiles instead of a stale distribution.

MAX_OPEN_POSITIONS was in APPROVED_PARAMETER_PROFILE_WHITELIST but never mapped to a config attribute, making profile-driven changes to it a silent no-op. Added to int_fields mapping. Also added mappings for the new SMALL_PROBE_* parameters so they are governable the same way.

expected_effect_summary.d_balanced_small_probe_simulation_over_l: 6/64 valid candidates would have promoted to approve_trade across 4 distinct tickers (AVAX-USDC, BTC-USDC, ETH-USDC, SOL-USDC) -- see reports/backtests/recent-market-parameter-sweetspot-latest.md for the full per-profile comparison.
expected_effect_summary.which_blocker_this_relieves: The judge_approve_trade=0 bottleneck identified in reports/audits/entry-funnel-72h-latest.md (valid_trade_plan=64 -> judge_approve_trade=0).
expected_effect_summary.trade_frequency_estimate: Roughly 1 small-probe candidate per 12h of live trading in a comparably trending market (6 candidates / 72h across 8 tickers), each capped at 20-25 USDC quote size.
expected_effect_summary.confidence: HIGH for the mechanism (deterministic replay of real recorded analyst scores); MEDIUM for future frequency (market-regime dependent).

activation_instructions: 1. This profile's parameter values are ALREADY the live defaults in bot/config.py as of this fix -- no .env change or approved-profile activation is required to get the effect.

2. To govern/rotate these values later via the existing approved-profile route: write them into state/approved_parameter_profile.json, set APPROVED_PARAMETER_PROFILE_HASH via tools/activate_approved_parameter_profile.py, set ENABLE_APPROVED_PARAMETER_PROFILE=true.
3. Restart the bot process to pick up the bot/strategy_engine.py and bot/config.py changes (this is a code change, not just a config value).
4. Monitor reports/audits/entry-funnel-72h-latest.md (re-run tools/trace_entry_funnel.py) over the next 24-48h for judge_approve_trade > 0.

5. Rollback: set SMALL_PROBE_MAX_BEAR_BULL_GAP=4 and SMALL_PROBE_REQUIRE_HTF_BOTH_TIMEFRAMES=false (or any subset) via the same approved-profile route to partially or fully revert without a code deploy.
